review_finding: This primary report explicitly attributes the five supports of Islam to the Prophet. Its first item expresses Allah's oneness without an explicit Muhammad clause, and Ramadan fasting precedes pilgrimage. It also includes Ibn Umar correcting the reverse order. Deen Muslim85 puts pilgrimage before fasting and omits the follow-up dialogue; it is a condensed/variant parallel, not asserted to be this exact witness.
work: Sahih Muslim16a, The Book of Faith
